workItems.title: Получения полноценных модели с достоверными метрическими данными
workItems.description: Получения достовреныз 3д моделей с метрическими данными готовых для построения полноценных выдачей польщователю и обработке построения глобальныхз 3Д моделей

acceptanceCriteria.text: all required frames/camera roles form an accepted globally consistent trajectory and component structure.
scale and geometry are constrained by calibrated stereo, ToF, IMU/ground truth as applicable—not merely reported afterward.
preregistered measurements meet explicit absolute/relative error thresholds on representative scenes.
dense/mesh tooling exists; final mesh validity, texture coverage and reproducibility are not accepted.

workItems.title: Использщование камеры Insta360
workItems.description: подключение и испольщование камеры для построяния 3Д туров

acceptanceCriteria.text: the app connects to the X4, captures intended photo/video media and associates it with the tour workflow.
current hardware regression confirms capture/upload/view after recent repository changes.
metric SfM use requires new calibration/processing criteria if the user intends it.

workItems.title: APP record Automatic photo capture to Photo SfM/viewer
workItems.description: создание высоких разшенрением снимков с одного телеыона для обработки модели с сипольщование IMU  + TOF для построеня 3Д модели с метричискимиданными

acceptanceCriteria.text: physical-device automatic capture preserves full-resolution images, usable timestamps and calibration and reaches server storage.
the server produces a sparse/dense result and viewer entry without manual intervention.
required IMU and ToF sidecars are uploaded and actively consumed for the intended metric result.
end-to-end runtime evidence records image count, registration/components, artifact validity and metric error.

workItems.title: APP Android + USB камера
workItems.description: Запись стерео видео с возмоджным иполльщованием IMU + TOF для посторояния конечной 3д модели с размерами

acceptanceCriteria.text: phone/USB roles, calibration and synchronized pairs survive capture and package validation on a physical device.
required ToF sidecars are persisted and reach processing.
pair clouds and trajectory are generated and accumulated; complete global fusion/optimization is not accepted.
F02 device/build preflight and graphics-station runtime acceptance pass on a representative dataset.
output meets a declared global metric and mesh/texturing gate.

workItems.title: APP Android инструмент для работы с заказами и сьемкой материалов для построения 3Д модели
workItems.description:
Работа с сервером для получения заказов/заявок
выбор заявки и сьемка с помощью доступнфз инструментов. камера. дополнительные камеры, датчики IMU , TOF и вспомогательные инструменты.
передача на сервер в заказ для дальнейшей обработки.
возможна работа для построения 3д модели с сипольщованием локально пк или ноутбкуа.

acceptanceCriteria.text: every supported capture emits the canonical identity, mode, roles, timestamps/clock relation, calibration, media, telemetry, integrity and lifecycle fields.
artifacts survive local persistence and resumable upload without silent loss.
the server accepts or explicitly rejects every declared mode against a versioned contract; current dual aggregate is rejected unexpectedly.
fixtures prove backward compatibility for current SINGLE, Auto Photo, MASTER/SLAVE, laptop-live and USB modes.

workItems.title: Dollhouse, floorplan and photorealistic viewer
workItems.description: Получения полноценных реалистичныз 3Д моделей для просмотра и работы с нмии в реальном масштабе.

acceptanceCriteria.text: existing 360 and basic SfM artifacts can be viewed through current routes.
accepted metric model renders as a navigable dollhouse with stable scale/camera framing.
floorplan is generated/linked and validated against the model.
textured photorealistic model meets declared browser performance and visual-quality gates.
MASTER controls SLAVE recording and persists camera roles, clock samples, per-phone video and IMU.
aggregate dual bundle is accepted by the production upload contract.
required ToF is captured/persisted/uploaded for both roles.
downstream processing uses both calibrated roles and clock mapping to produce an optimized global result.
an order and capture session persist, uploaded 360 media is associated, and an authorized private/public tour can render it. Evidence: PHP/DB paths plus recorded MVP documentation.
repeat the order → upload → publish smoke test on the current deployment without manual database repair.

workItems.title: APP 2 android phone + notebook/pc
workItems.description:
построение на локальном компьютере через сеть wifi
возможность или доступность испольщовния  IMU  + TOF для коенчной расчета модели с размерами

acceptanceCriteria.text: two phone streams reach one host with stable role/session identity, usable clock relation and calibration.
IMU/ToF packets reach the host with integrity/coverage diagnostics; present transport is reduced live data, not a durable canonical bundle.
the host or server consumes both cameras and telemetry in global alignment/fusion/optimization.
an end-to-end run produces a valid metric cloud/mesh with stated accuracy.

workItems.title: Server storage and GrafikStation job orchestration
workItems.description:
обработка полученных данных на серврер и передача доп обработки на графическую станци.
принимает данные из андроид приложения 
обрабатывает данные полученные с андроид приложения
публицирует готовые резульатты
ведет учет заявок межжу брокерами и исполнителями.
готовые модели доступнгы для просмотра зарезервированныз и не зарезервированныз польщователей
должен отслеживать получения вспомогательныз данных IMU , TOF и возмодно подключаемых другиз данных если они будут доступны

acceptanceCriteria.text: authorized station can claim, heartbeat and finish supported jobs and register result artifacts.
supported capture packages are schema-validated, integrity-checked and durably associated with order/session/mode/roles.
every active capture branch, especially dual aggregate, is accepted under one compatible contract.
orchestration records whether IMU/ToF were absent, diagnostic-only or actively consumed.
integration fixtures cover each capture mode and each dispatched job with valid/invalid artifact outcomes.

workItems.title: APP  SINGLE baseline
workItems.description: Запись видео с возмоджным иполльщованием IMU + TOF для посторояния конечной 3д модели с размерами

acceptanceCriteria.text: a SINGLE capture records video, IMU and ToF sidecars and the server retains them.
the sparse pipeline produces diagnostics for registration, components, points, reprojection error, trajectory, first/last frame and endpoint distance.
controlled long-range visual links improve connectivity without exhaustive matching; v1 supports this, isolated v2 is NOT_RUN.
IMU participates as a mapper/optimization pose or gravity prior; current use is selection/diagnostic only.
ToF participates as an active metric/geometric constraint and changes the reconstructed solution.
a predeclared physical-ground-truth test demonstrates repeatable scale/trajectory improvement and acceptable metric error.

workItems.title: Обработчик на графической станции.
workItems.description:
получает задания с сервера и выполняет для построения 3Д модели через DENSE COLMAP полноценной 3Д модели. после выполнения отдает резульат обратно сервера
должен уметь рабоатть с вспомогательными данными IMU , TOF и возмодно подключаемых другиз данных если они будут доступны

acceptanceCriteria.text: sparse/dense/PLY/mesh and synchronized-dense commands emit validated artifacts rather than relying only on exit status.
diagnostics quantify components, trajectory and sensor coverage.
IMU/ToF alter optimization as active constraints and the effect is measured A/B.
stereo pair clouds undergo accepted global alignment, fusion, optimization/loop handling and mesh/texturing.
Hybrid v2 and latest stereo path run in isolation with command/manifest/audit agreement.

dependencies.rationale: UVC/stereo work can and did proceed against fixtures while contract unification remains active.
Metric reconstruction research can start on frozen datasets; final acceptance requires server/worker evidence.
SINGLE already runs; shared contract and sensor-prior work are parallelizable.
Business UI and orchestration can co-develop against schema and fixtures.
Laptop-live is an independent prototype that can converge on the common contract in parallel.
Automatic Photo already uses a dedicated endpoint and can converge on the shared envelope in parallel.
Client and server contract must be co-designed; neither complete tile blocks the other's start.
Duplicate relation; human confirmation is required before removal.
Role/control capture exists and server acceptance can be repaired against fixtures concurrently.
Worker runners can be developed from frozen jobs; integration acceptance requires both.
Camera integration and tour ingestion are independently testable.
Viewer implementation can use frozen assets; production acceptance requires the final model.
